verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.wandb.ai/llms.txt and markdown doc pages such as weave.md that point agents to a full documentation index. The official MCP server also gives AI assistants access to W&B documentation, and Skills cover the Weave SDK. Missing for 10: a Weave-specific llms.txt (the served index is CoreWeave-wide), a fix for the broken OpenAPI link listed in llms.txt (it returns 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
